name: Christ The Mediator
overview: Scripture reveals Christ as the sole Mediator who reconciles humanity to God by breaking down the dividing wall of enmity through His atoning sacrifice. By His flesh, He abolishes the law of commandments that separated us, uniting both Jew and Gentile into one new body of peace. Through Christ, those once far off are brought near and granted access to the Father by one Spirit, fulfilling the gospel covenant and surpassing the mediatorial roles of figures like Aaron and Moses.
